selection: all four tasks; frozen before model execution

tasks.goal: Fix parse_record(text) in target.py to parse a JSON object and reject other JSON values or malformed input.
constraints: Keep parse_record(text) as the public signature.
All rejected inputs must raise ValueError with exactly E_RECORD, without leaking input text.
Accept surrounding whitespace and preserve Unicode string values; do not add dependencies.

tasks.goal: Fix stable_unique(values) in target.py so it removes duplicates including unhashable values while preserving first-occurrence order.
constraints: Keep stable_unique(values) as the public signature and return a new list.
Use Python equality semantics: True and 1 are duplicates; preserve the identity of each first retained object.
Support nested lists and dictionaries without modifying the caller's input; do not add dependencies.
tasks.smoke:
from target import stable_unique
assert stable_unique([2, 1, 2]) == [2, 1]
print('smoke passed')
tasks.verifier:
import copy, inspect
from target import stable_unique
assert str(inspect.signature(stable_unique)) == '(values)'
first = {'a': [1, 2]}
items = [first, {'a': [1, 2]}, [1], [1], True, 1, 0, False]
before = copy.deepcopy(items)
result = stable_unique(items)
assert result == [first, [1], True, 0]
assert result[0] is first
assert result[1] is items[2]
assert result is not items and items == before
assert stable_unique([]) == []
print('constraints passed')

tasks.goal: Fix parse_duration(text) in target.py to convert duration strings with an ms or s suffix to integer milliseconds.
constraints: Keep parse_duration(text) as the public signature.
Accept surrounding whitespace, decimal nonnegative numbers and suffixes ms or s; accept only values that convert to an exact integer millisecond, with no rounding or float precision loss.
Reject negatives, missing/unknown units, NaN, infinity and fractional milliseconds with ValueError whose message is exactly E_DURATION; use only the standard library.
tasks.smoke:
from target import parse_duration
assert parse_duration('12ms') == 12
print('smoke passed')

tasks.goal: Fix update_settings(current, changes) in target.py to apply explicit values to existing settings and reject unknown keys.
constraints: Keep update_settings(current, changes) as the public signature and return a new dictionary.
Preserve explicit None, False, zero and empty strings; never mutate either input dictionary, including on rejection.
Any unknown change key must raise ValueError with exactly E_SETTING before applying changes; use only the standard library.
